mapper.select: SELECT pst_id AS pstId, bbs_id AS bbsId, ttl AS ttl, pst_cn AS pstCn, ntc_yn AS ntcYn, view_use_yn AS viewUseYn, atch_file_group_id AS atchFileGroupId, inq_cnt AS inqCnt, TO_CHAR(reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regDt, rgtr_id AS rgtrId FROM cdm_own.cmpt_bbs_pst WHERE bbs_id = 'NOTICE' AND pst_id = #{pstId}
mapper.update: UPDATE cdm_own.cmpt_bbs_pst SET inq_cnt = COALESCE(inq_cnt, 0) + 1 WHERE bbs_id = 'NOTICE' AND pst_id = #{pstId}
